overall_notes: This paper is primarily about probing internal representations of language models (specifically BART and T5) to understand whether they encode semantic state information. While the models do generate text (instructions in Alchemy domain and game actions/responses in TextWorld domain), the paper does not evaluate the quality of these generations using automatic metrics, LLM judges, or human evaluation. Instead, it evaluates how well internal representations encode semantic state information using linear probes.
